summary: Re-key a Fabric fleet member in one command with signed policy receipts and bounded overlap

replay.detail: Existing signed member-endpoint claims carry rotation and receipt metadata; no claim replay is required.

schema.detail: No database schema change; fleet member endpoints include non-routing Fabric rotation and receipt metadata.

rules.detail: Adapters stage an expiring next NodeID, confirm installed policy, and commit the new endpoint before guarded local activation.

compatibility.detail: Re-key requires Fabric v0.9.4 identity and runtime expiry APIs and updated Fractal adapters on confirming peers.

downtime.detail: Fabric activation restarts its local endpoint; existing Fabric tunnels reconnect. Offline peers may need membership recovery.

manual.detail: Run fractal fleet transports rekey fabric on the rotating member. At least one remote member must confirm both phases within ten minutes.

recovery.detail: Rerun the same command after interruption to resume its durable journal without extending the deadline. No confirmation aborts with the old identity active; uncertain activation retries guarded reconciliation. Static and other-owner grants remain operator-owned.
